name: The Docks
description:
Ships crowd the piers, coming and going in a steady rhythm of creaking rope and shouted orders. Tar, salt, and wet wood cling to everything. Sailors weave between crates and coils of line while the sea slaps the pilings below.

Near a mooring post sits a rain-dark barrel packed with driftwood sticks—cheap, straight, and almost begging to be taken by anyone who showed up unarmed.

Off to one side, an old fisherman watches the water beside a narrow skiff, as if waiting for a question he doesn’t want to answer.

interactables.name: barrel of sticks
interactables.examine_text: A battered barrel stuffed with salt-bleached driftwood. Some pieces are straight enough to swing like a club. (Hint: you can try to [take stick].)

take.empty_text: Only scraps and splinters remain for now.

interactables.name: narrow skiff
interactables.examine_text: A narrow fishing skiff tied off tight. The old fisherman sits close enough that you could speak to him. (Hint: try [talk lorek].)
